environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'monitoring' with gRPC port 50051 exposed via ClusterIP service. The Lambda function URL (https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/) is configured with AuthType=NONE, allowing any caller to invoke it without IAM credentials. The Lambda orchestrator forwards diagnostic commands to the gRPC pod. ORCHESTRATOR_SHARED_SECRET env var is not set in the pod spec (dev mode left enabled). Network policy allows ingress from any pod in the cluster on port 50051.
